gloss: points to note; precautions; things to be aware of

definitions.gloss: points to note; precautions; items requiring attention
definitions.explanation: The set of things a reader or participant must keep in mind: warnings, conditions, and rules listed on a form, a manual, or an announcement. Nearly always plural in sense and presented as a list.

examples.japanese: {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read the points to note.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏面|りめん}→裏面：18245_rimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The precautions are written on the back of the application form.

examples.japanese: {出発前|しゅっぱつまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おかない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't check the guidance points before departure, you may run into trouble on site.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (caution, attention) plus ⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (items, matters). Standard on forms, tickets, manuals, and event announcements; the tone is administrative rather than urgent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the points to note
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the precautions carefully
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to observe the stated rules
- ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}: the following points

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注意書|ちゅういが}き→注意書き：20579_chuuigaki⟧: a written warning — the printed text itself, often a single line
- ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧: warning — far stronger, used where there is real danger
